name: Ziply Fiber
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public ziplyfiber.com help center pages only (no sign-in). Ziply Fiber is the former Frontier Northwest ILEC (WA, OR, ID, MT); home phone is billed on the same Ziply Fiber account. a security code is emailed during setup and registration needs the billing account number, account PIN and billing ZIP (PIN is not expressible, so accountNumber + zip + email are modelled). The sign-in identifier is inferred to be the email address (the public pages do not name it; "Ziply ID" appears only in page analytics, so it is not used as a label). Payments: Billing tab > Make a Payment (Total balance / Current balance due / Pay another amount); one-time credit card payments carry a fee of up to 3% (modelled as 3%), debit card and ACH are free; phone payments at 1.866.947.5955 carry a service fee whose amount is not published. There is no public pay-without-signing-in page: Ziply can text a single-use payment link (billing ZIP, amount, method) to the primary account user after the customer contacts them, so guest_pay is modelled offline. Autopay: Set up autopay > choose how many days before the due date the payment applies (a per-customer lead time not expressible); $10/month discount with debit or ACH, $5/month with a credit card (discounts not modelled); turn off with Manage autopay > TURNED ON toggle > YES, TURN OFF. Paperless: Billing > Total balance > TURN ON / TURN OFF; no paper fee published. Cancellation and moving to a lower speed are by chat or phone (1.866.699.4759); no fee to cancel residential service; final bill arrives on the regular bill date 2-4 weeks later, bills are 30 days in advance and are not prorated; equipment back within 45 days. Payment arrangements are by phone at 1.888.488.0032. Scheduled-payment limits and late fees are not published (family defaults kept). Reviewed 2026-10-10 (t20 review): re-checked pay, autopay, cancel, setup and make-account-changes pages; sign-in label changed from "Ziply ID (email)" to "Email address" because no public page names a Ziply ID.

guest_pay.note: There is no online payment page without logging in. After you contact us, Ziply Fiber can text a one-time payment link to the primary account user, or you can pay by phone at 1.866.947.5955 with your 17-digit account number.

autopay.note: Autopay saves $10 a month with a debit card or bank account (ACH), or $5 a month with a credit card. You choose how many days before the due date each payment applies.

cancel_service.note: Service can't be cancelled in My Account. Chat with a live agent or call 1.866.699.4759. There is no fee to cancel residential fiber service.

change_plan.note: Speed upgrades can be made on the Account tab, but moving to a lower speed needs a chat with a live agent or a call to 1.866.699.4759.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment arrangements are set up by phone. Call 1.888.488.0032.

notes: Phone payments at 1.866.947.5955 carry a service fee (amount not published).

help.title: Paying your Ziply Fiber bill
paragraphs: Log in to My Account or the Ziply Fiber app, open the Billing tab and choose Make a Payment. If autopay is already on you are asked to confirm first. Pick the total balance, the current balance due or another amount, then a saved method, a new card or a new bank account.
Debit card and bank (ACH) payments are free. One-time credit card payments carry a fee of up to 3% of the amount.

Without logging in, call 1.866.947.5955 with your 17-digit account number (a service fee applies; American Express is not taken by phone), or mail a check or money order payable to Ziply Fiber with your stub to P.O. Box 740416, Cincinnati, OH 45274-0416. Ziply can also text a one-time payment link to the primary account user after you contact us. For payment arrangements call 1.888.488.0032.

help.title: Autopay
paragraphs: From the Home or Billing tab choose Set up autopay, add or pick a payment method, and choose how many days before the due date each payment should apply.
Autopay takes $10 a month off with a debit card or bank account, or $5 a month with a credit card.
To change it, choose Manage autopay, then Edit. To stop it, choose Manage autopay, select the Turned On toggle and confirm with Yes, turn off.
steps: Log in and open the Home or Billing tab.
Add or select a payment method.
Choose how many days before the due date to pay, then Continue.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Log in, open Billing, and use the button under the paperless status in the Total balance section: Turn on to stop paper bills, Turn off to get them by mail again.

help.title: Cancel your Ziply Fiber service
paragraphs: Cancelling, moving to a lower speed, seasonal service and billing name or address changes are handled by a live agent in chat or by phone at 1.866.699.4759. There is no contract and no fee to cancel residential fiber service.
Bills cover 30 days in advance and are not prorated. Your final bill comes on your regular bill date, usually 2 to 4 weeks after disconnection. Return equipment within 45 days to avoid charges.

extra.intent: Using Ziply Fiber's help center, find how much the monthly autopay discount is when you pay with a debit card or bank account. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: The autopay discount is $10 a month with debit or ACH.
